text:
tara (People Ops): Need quick routing: hiring requests an above-band base + expedited sign-on for a candidate already overseas. Can we fast-track?
aj (Recruiter): Candidate is Zoe Kim. Offer converts to ~$124k which is slightly above L5 cap; manager requests $5k sign-on to secure acceptance. Candidate wants Apr 20 start.

rio (Hiring Manager): This hire is blocking DB migration. If we don't close this week we slip sprints. Request exec-comp exception and 48hr turnaround. Happy to add a 2-line impact note.

pat (Finance): Need simple calc + headcount slot. Quick: base=124000, benefits~=27280, sign-on=5000, est_yr_cost~=156280. Provide GL for sign-on and headcount doc.

minty (Legal): Note: verify work authorization and include conditional start clause "pending payroll & visa". Accelerated approvals ok but document in offer.

tara (People Ops): I'll open APPR-5421, attach offer, finance calc, and headcount memo. Request 48hr SLA and tag exec-comp + legal. aj please upload the offer link.

aj (Recruiter): Uploaded /files/ZoeK-offer.pdf and headcount doc https://docs.internal/zoe-headcount. Candidate ok to wait if approvals take a few days.

approvals-bot: Approval request APPR-5421 created. Status: pending. Routed to: exec-comp, finance, legal. SLA: 48 hours. Link: https://approvals.internal/APPR-5421

pat (Finance): Provisionally OK on sign-on if recruiting maps GL SIG-ONE-21. Will confirm within 24h.

rio (Hiring Manager): Adding business-impact note now. Available for a 10-min sync if needed.

tara (People Ops): If approved, we'll set start date "pending payroll & immigration" and insert conditional sign-on language. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've left your approval comment on APPR-5421.

(rio) :thumbsup: (pat) :thumbsup: (minty) :eyes:
